occurrences.text: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
